sourceText:
Domikey x Glove Link Fire Cherry Profile keycaps
After SA APES TIME , GLOVE team and Domikey start a new design project - Link Fire.
'Before the world was formed, there weren't any lives except trees and immortal ancient dragons. No days and nights. However, one day, the unknown fire was burnt under a tree, which divided the world into day and night. Creatures seem to be awakened by the fire, tethering from here and there. '
The image blooms into their mind when GLOVE team plays Dark Souls III. Then, Link Fire project starts.
GLOVE team and Domikey collaborated already two beautiful keycaps in SA profile. They decided to try something new. Cherry profile is a new keycap line of Domikey. Then Link Fire on Cherry profile is coming.
SPEC
Cherry profile (sculpted 1-1-2-3-4-4)
Compatible with Cherry MX and clones
ABS plastic
Doubleshot legends\Tripleshot Jan legends
Stripe bottom
Design Concept
The story is about passing the fire. Making self as firewood burnt is to last the brightness of the world.
When buring self, people’s body keeps in good condition, however, the soul is fading gradually. Since that, those who burn themselves turns to be a walking dead. Cinder stands for the burned ash that lighting slightly.
Though there are many people burning themselves generations by generations, the world still goes to the Dark. Would you like to burn yourself like those pinoeers?
The whole story is full of desperation. But there is still a weak but warm flame in such dark world.
Therefore, the Link Fire theme features dark blue as its key tone. Also, adding retro grey white colour stands for the ash and bones in burning. The warm orange colour means the little flame in the dark world. The little flame lights up the dark world, generating the bright blue.
After few times adjusting, GLOVE adds 1.75u Shift in MOD kit and extra B ke and R3 back slash (\|) key in Alpha kit.
Buying extra MOD kit, there would be two keyboards with one keycapset.

The flame stands for the fire passing loop.

sourceText:
ABS Etched, Shine-Through
These ABS etched keycaps feature a shine-through design that brings life to the legends, which feature popular emoticons. Available in black and red, they’re sure to add a splash of whimsy and color to any keyboard.
Attention:Keycaps only, not including other things.
Clouds, sometimes referred to as "auspicious clouds" (xiangyun 祥云), represent the heavens and also "good luck" because the Chinese word for cloud (yun 云) is pronounced the same as yun (运) meaning "luck" or "fortune".
Its form often resembles the auspicious shape of the lingzhi "fungus of immortality".
The cloud is a commonly seen design and when repeated in a pattern symbolizes never-ending fortune.
Auspicious clouds may be seen on coins and charms at the following: Auspicious Inscriptions, Chinese Coins with Charm Features, Buddhist Charms, Daoist Charms.

name: Domikey BoW Cherry Profile Hirigana JP Dye Subbed Keycap Set thick PBT for keyboard Black on White BM60 CSTC75 BM65 BM68 XD60
sourceText:
Domikey BOW Cherry profile Keycaps
The BOW stands for “black on white” in Domikey’s BOW Dye-Sublimated Keycap Kit—so you can expect to get a clean, white canvas to type on. The pristine, dark-black legends are dye-sublimated on each PBT keycap, which means they’ll stay stark for a long time and the whole construction will resist fade and shine. Plus, the Cherry Profile feels classic and familiar, helping with the tried-and-true design of the set. There are three options—a classic two-tone black-and white kit, plus two kits with red or blue character accents for a little bit of extra flair. It’s a typing solution that really is black and white—or a little colorful, if you want that too.
SPEC
Profile: Cherry
Material: Dye-sublimated PBT
Compatible with Cherry MX switches and clones
KEYCAPS ONLY NO OTHER PARTS

displayName: GLOVE x Domikey Adventurer 冒険家 tripleshot
sourceText:
GLOVE x Domikey Adventrurer Cherry Profile Doubleshot Keycaps
GLOVE is inspired by an adventure that a warrior saves the princess. The warrior wears his green battle suit, climbs over hills and mountains, pass through the forest to save his princess.
Meanwhile, it is a theme about Spring Camping. We need to go outside and camp in Spring, to feel the nature. We can go to travel, go camping, etc.
General SPEC
ABS Doubleshot
Cherry profile
Stripe bottom
Tripleshot Japanese sublegends
ABOUT DESIGN
At the beginning, GLOVE intends to create different colour schemes for ALPHA kit, one is mainly Blue, the other is mainly Green.
After collecting the feedback from the community, he finally decided to remove the blue Alpha design. Since the Green suit is more classical colour scheme for a warrior like Peter Pan. The green suit, yellow hair and brown feather glove. Therefore, GLOVE adds brown colour in green Alpha.
Since GLOVE wanted to use two different colours on Alpha, GLOVE had to remove blue and green from the MOD kit and white novel kit and used yellow characters. However, the character is hard to recognize. Eventually, GLOVE adjusted the colour of character to green for the MOD kit and White Novel.
There are 60 novels in total. In Base Pro kit, there are 28 novels so that the Base kit is more interesting. In Novel kit, there are 32 Novels.
Weirdo Link Novelty
Material: Resin
Manufacturer: ZMKC
Includes: ID card (the number is based on the order of placing orders), collection box, collection base, stickers
Associated Theme Mousepad
The lovely Jelly wares a pair of Spirit ears, cosplays as the warrior in blue suit and Green suit.
The figure that printed on the mousepad is drew by Natural Pride Studio and GLOVE.
SIZE: 900 x 400 x5 mm
Material: natural rubber, multispandex, stitched edge
Process: heat transfer printing
